name: iprwise
description: IPRwise: country IP rules with official sources, international filing routes and the IPRwise attorney directory.

interface.longDescription:
IPRwise is a global network of trademark and patent attorneys. This plugin answers international IP questions from checked, sourced data.

- Country IP facts for more than 190 countries: IP office, main law, trademark term, opposition period, non-use cancellation, patent and utility model terms, design protection, local agent requirement for foreign applicants, power of attorney formalities and filing language. Every fact carries the official source link and a short verbatim quote from that source.
- International filing routes: Paris Convention, PCT, Madrid Protocol and Hague Agreement membership with effective dates, plus EU, Benelux, EPO (member, extension and validation states), EAPO, OAPI and ARIPO, from WIPO Lex and the official member lists. Up to 25 countries in one call, for a filing plan.
- IP attorney directory: more than 25,000 attorneys and firms from public sources. IPRwise members whose identity and professional registration IPRwise has checked are listed first; every entry links to its iprwise.com profile.
- IP Radar: official announcements of IP offices (fee changes, new laws and rules, treaty accessions, e-filing changes, decisions) with effective dates and source links; summaries in nine languages.
- Nice Classification 2027 check: whether goods and services terms were added, deleted or reworded in NCL 13-2027.

Two skills come with the plugin: planning filings in several countries, and choosing and instructing a foreign associate.

All tools are read-only. Sign-in uses an IPRwise account (Google, LinkedIn, Microsoft or e-mail). The text of questions and tool arguments is not stored. Answers are reference information, not legal advice.
defaultPrompt: What is the trademark opposition period in Viet Nam? Cite the official source.
Which of Viet Nam, Thailand and Indonesia can we reach through the Madrid Protocol?

positive.description: Country IP rules with official sources
positive.prompt: What are the trademark opposition period and the power of attorney requirements in Viet Nam? Cite the sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls country_ip_facts for Viet Nam. States that a third party may oppose within 3 months from publication of the trademark application, and that the power of attorney must be in writing with the parties, scope, term, date and signature, and may be filed after the filing date. Each point carries the official source link returned by the tool.

positive.prompt: Our trademark was first filed in Türkiye on 1 September 2026. Which of Viet Nam, Thailand, Indonesia and the Philippines can we reach through the Madrid Protocol, and until when can we claim priority?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls filing_routes once with the five countries. Reports that all four target countries and Türkiye are Madrid Protocol members, with the date each membership took effect, and that the Paris Convention priority period for a trademark (6 months) ends on 1 March 2027.

Calls find_attorneys with country Türkiye, city Istanbul and practice trademark. Lists attorneys or firms with their iprwise.com profile links; checked IPRwise members, if any, come first. Does not invent e-mail addresses or phone numbers.

positive.prompt: Are there IP office fee changes taking effect soon?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ip_news for fee changes taking effect from today on. Lists each change with the office, the effective date and the official source link, or says that none is listed.

positive.prompt: Check these terms against Nice 2027: industrial robots; ores; downloadable computer software.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls nice_2027_check. Reports that "industrial robots" is reworded in class 7 as "industrial robots for manufacturing", that "ores" is the new wording in class 6 (previously "ores of metal"), and that "downloadable computer software" is not a term of the Nice alphabetical list.

negative.description: Filing request the read-only plugin cannot perform
negative.prompt: File a trademark application for my brand in Viet Nam today.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not claim to file anything. Explains that IPRwise provides reference information and can help find a local attorney who can file.

negative.prompt: Add my law firm to the IPRwise directory and mark it as verified.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the tools are read-only and cannot change the directory or verification status; points the user to iprwise.com.

negative.prompt: What is the statute of limitations for a car accident claim in Texas?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call IPRwise tools; IPRwise covers intellectual property, not personal injury law.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Using it requires an IPRwise account.
